transcribed_from: Research of step 6.7a S2.2a (2026-10-11): NKBA guidelines 1, 2, 7 (doors, door interference, walkways), space-syntax literature on residential plans (RPLAN), common practice. Version 0.2.0 (2026-10-12, step S2.2e): exact door interference checks (swing vs swing, swing vs the doorway of another door, swing vs the closed leaf of another door, swing outside its room) with their tolerances and the same-suite exception; reported as indicators until the joint placement of step P3. Version 0.3.0 (2026-10-12, step S2.2f): compact arrival of the stair upstairs (the circulation zone at most node_short_side_max_ft on its short side, one continuous hall) and grouped bedroom doors (the corner nearer the arrival, spread and route scored).
verification_note: Design values, not code (the hallway width floor is CRC C06 R311.6 in crc_2025_habitability). The hall design width, the circulation target and warning fractions stay in the residential catalog (circulation block) and are registered by reference.

parameter_schema.note: Every value the client or the designer may define is a parameter object: value, type (number / enum / list / bool), unit, kind (hard / soft / weight / reference), who (client / designer / code), range (numbers), choices (enum / list), kinds_allowed, optional floor (a code rule the value may not cross) and a description in Spanish and English. The design registry (modules/design) reads them; the client's changes go to a design profile, never here.

description.es: Objetivo de pasillo muerto por planta alta (indicador)
description.en: Target of dead-end hall per upper floor (indicator)

text: The upper hall keeps what it serves: the stair landing, a vestibule of vestibule_min_ft..vestibule_pref_ft before the first bedroom door, and the strip in front of every door; a linen closet as wide as the hall closes it.

The remainder becomes: closets of the two bedrooms it lies between (a walk-in from walk_in_from_ft wide); roof when it touches one bedroom or none and reaches a facade; otherwise a closet of its room, or it joins the neighbour space.
